notes.title: Oafmatch 1.0.4 is out! Cloud Save support!
notes.content:
[b]Oafmatch 1.0.4[/b]
Rejoices oafes and oafes for a new version is upon you!
Many interresting things in there, most notably Steam Cloud Save support!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam Cloud Save support
[*]Corrected icon of Warlord's Maul
[*]Summoner's damage correctly increases at rank 3
[*]Dying properly removes all buffs/debuffs (including potion effects)
[*]Dragons in zone 6 and 7 use the correct image in conversations
[*]Selection, pan info properly reset in party menu when switching save files
[*]Runewarriors get mana for matching gems with extra lives
[*]Scouts properly explode yellow gems
[*]Characters in the back row remain there when moving to the next wave
[*]Updated description of thief's special ability to state that it also works with wild matches
[*]Fixed description of Staff of Storms
[*]Alchemist's passive ability is now properly constrained by her rank
[*]Healer's passive ability applies to the healer himself as well as his companions
[*]No longer display "perfect bonus" after battles in roguelike mode. (Still gives just as much gold, though)
[*]Added control for terrain animation speed
[*]Added control for enemy turn speed
[*]Added option to disable camera shakes
[*]Agrinji's Dungeon chests only drop a single item
[*]Agrinji's Dungeon boss chests drop two items
[*]Agrinji's Dungeon chests can drop max-rank loot even on the dungeon's first level
[*]Roguelike winners will be able to load their savefiles (though there's not much to do in the dungeon once you've won!)
[*]Roguelike winners can choose to restart with their winning savefile
[*]Characters not in the current party in roguelike mode now display correct health values
[*]Community buffs no longer activate right at the end of a fight
[*]Health fountains no longer spawn in the final room of a roguelike level, since the party will be healed upon descending to the next level anyway
[*]Added option to disable automatic move suggestions
[*]Added command in combat for getting a move suggestion
[*]Updated graphic for move suggestions
[*]Agrinji's Dungeon properly increases monster levels at deeper depths
[*]Fixed bug with resurrection fountain sometimes having an empty option when showing list of dead characters
[/list]

Have fun, and go fix problems with violence [i](and strategy)[/i]

notes.title: Oafmatch 1.0.3 released!
notes.content:
[b]Oafmatch 1.0.3[/b]
Continuing the trend of carring about your feedback, here comes 1.0.3!
Rejoices oafes and oafes!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added keybindings for previous foe and next foe
[*]Fixed issue with certain commands not accepting certain keys after binding them
[*]Fixed issue with Vorpal Crossbow incorrectly giving mana for destroyed gems
[*]Fixed issue with incorrect potions getting equipped after game load
[*]Fixed issue with green manastrike potion having the wrong graphic
[*]Fixed issue with broken cages in roguelike mode
[*]Fixed issue with level display in equipment tab after training
[*]Fixed issue with lengthy descriptions overflowing the text box on the map
[*]Soulseekers will inflict stuns of the correct duration
[*]Clerics will heal based on damage actually dealt, not base damage
[*]Training in roguelike mode will now update current health values of characters to maintain their current health to maximum health ratio
[*]Contortionists will correctly update their health in combat
[*]Contortionists in roguelike mode will lose their bonus health after battles
[*]Amulet of Epiphany will no longer target wild gems
[*]Updating Swashbuckler's description to specify that her Ambidexterity applies once per turn
[*]Swashbuckler's mana discount will no longer incorrectly display after the turn ends
[*]Charm of Stone's boulder gem will be darkened to look more like other terrain gems
[*]All conversations are always be skippable in Campaign+
[*]Fixed Simultaneity achievement
[*]Rearranged abilities on double-size boss cards to make room for manacounters
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Oafmatch 1.0.2 released!
notes.content:
[b]Oafmatch 1.0.2![/b]
So little time has passed since the game is out and there is already an update thanks to all your nice feedback!
Many fixes big and small; and most importantly hopefully better distinguisable gems for colorblind people.

Also sadly the login infos in the last version were saved in a weird way and wont transfer. You'll just need to
re-login ingame, wont happen in next version anymore :)
If you have not registered, consider it, you can talk to people and see their amazing combos and soon on https://oafmatch.com/ I'll add random useless fun stats to marvel at! :)

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*]Added support for pasting text ingame
[*]Added hide/unhide password toggle
[*]Added options for filtering chat, controlling threshold for combo notifications
[*]Modified gem images to help make them more colorblind friendly
[*]Added option for controlling gem speed
[*]Fixed glitch that involves canceling the opening of a crate in roguelike mode
[*]Added hint about going back to complete old fights on harder difficulties
[*]Fixed pronoun usage in combo notices
[*]Added ability to deselect chat line with a gamepad
[*]Added ability to cancel gem targeting with gamepad
[*]Toned down animation on stun effect
[*]Fixed arena reward bug
[*]Fixed display issue with long logins/passwords
[*]Charm of Stone's falling boulder will now grant mana from crushed gems, as stated in its description
[*]Fixed party movement bug on world map
[*]Autoequipping weapons into empty slots will no longer unequip two-handed legendary weapons
[*]Fixed Champion of Mendra achievement
[*]Updated loading screen image
[*]Updated effects for dead and stunned foes
[*]Updated credits
[*]Added correct default values for chat options
[*]Fixed welcome dialog appearing inappropriately after game updates get installed
[*]Changed login system to not reset each update
[/list]

Have fun fixing problems with violence!
